The menu and daily specials are difficult to locate and are presented in a non-mobile-optimized format (e.g., a PDF download), leading to significant user friction and potential abandonment for customers checking options on the go.
solutionsProposed: Implement a robust, multi-layer cookie consent banner that appears prominently on the first visit. It must offer clear options for 'Accept All', 'Reject All', and 'Customize' (with categories like essential, analytics, marketing). Provide a clear link to the Privacy and Cookie Policy, and ensure users can easily change their preferences at any time via an accessible 'Cookie Settings' link or icon.

Redesign the menu section to be a dedicated, easily accessible page from the main navigation. Present the menu items directly on the webpage using a responsive design that adapts seamlessly to all devices. For daily specials, implement a prominent 'Today's Specials' section on the homepage or a quick-view pop-up, ensuring it's always up-to-date and scannable.
